titleEn: Distance Lends Enchantment to the View

items.promptEn: Years after leaving his old school, Pak remembered the friendly classmates but forgot the long daily journey.
items.promptZh: 離開舊學校多年後，阿柏只記得友善同學，卻忘了每天很長的車程。

options.text: Time had softened Pak’s memory of the long commute—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 時間距離讓困難細節淡化。

options.text: Pak still remembered the long commute vividly—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說他忘了長車程。

options.text: Pak had never travelled to that school—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說每天車程很長。

options.text: The old school was therefore perfect in every way—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 好同學不能證明學校各方面完美。

items.promptEn: Living abroad, Lok recalled winter festivals at home but forgot the frequent rain cancellations.
items.promptZh: 從海外回想家鄉冬天，阿樂只想起節日，忘了以前常因天雨取消活動。

options.text: Distance made Lok’s memories of home warmer by hiding rainy interruptions—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 身在遠方，記憶淡化了不便。

options.text: Lok recalled every cancelled event clearly—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說忘了取消活動。

options.text: There had never been any rain in winter—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說常因天雨取消。

options.text: The festivals prove all winters at home were easy—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 節日美好不代表整個冬天沒有難處。

items.promptEn: A distant farmhouse looked comfortable online; on arrival, Fai learned she had to draw water from a well.
items.promptZh: 網上看一間遠方農舍很舒適，到場後阿菲才知道要自己取井水。

options.text: The remote view was charming before Fai learned about the daily water chore—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 遠觀時沒有看到取水的日常工作。

options.text: The farmhouse had running water in every room—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 與到場才知要取井水相反。

options.text: Fai knew about the well before looking online—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 題目說到場後才知道。

options.text: The well proves the farmhouse is unsafe—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 取井水不等於房子不安全。

items.promptEn: Years later, Hong called his former job carefree; a friend reminded him of weekly overtime.
items.promptZh: 阿康多年後說舊工作無憂無慮，朋友卻提醒他當年每週都要加班。

options.text: Time made the old job seem easier than its weekly overtime suggests—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 遠離舊工作後，他淡忘了每週加班。

options.text: The old job involved no overtime at all—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 朋友指出每週加班。

options.text: Hong had never worked at that job—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 那確是他的舊工作。

options.text: Weekly overtime proves every day there was miserable—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 加班辛苦不等於每一天都悲慘。

items.promptEn: A harbour’s lights looked lovely from a distance; after moving there, Ling heard trucks at night.
items.promptZh: 遠處看見海港燈光很美，阿玲住下才感到夜間貨車噪音。

options.text: The distant harbour view concealed the noise of daily life—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 遠景美與近處噪音形成落差。

options.text: The neighbourhood was silent at night—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說夜間有貨車聲。

options.text: Ling had lived there before seeing the lights—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 她是搬去後才感到噪音。

options.text: The trucks prove the harbour lights were ugly—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 噪音不否定燈光美。

items.promptEn: Kin thought a hike looked easy in a friend’s photos; on the trail she met a long climb.
items.promptZh: 阿琴看朋友的登山照片覺得路程輕鬆，自己走時才發現連續上坡。

options.text: The remote image made the hike seem easier than it felt underfoot—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 照片淡化了實際路程的辛苦。

options.text: The trail was flat from start to finish—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文有連續上坡。

options.text: Kin had walked the trail before seeing the photos—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 她是親自走時才發現。

options.text: A climb proves the photographs were fake—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 照片不全面不代表造假。

items.promptEn: Years later, Shan missed the bustle of his old dormitory but forgot its unreliable heating.
items.promptZh: 多年後阿山懷念舊宿舍的熱鬧，卻忘了那裏的暖氣常壞。

options.text: Time made the dormitory seem cosier than its broken heating had allowed—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 懷舊時淡忘暖氣問題。

options.text: The heating had always worked perfectly—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說暖氣常壞。

options.text: Shan had never lived in the dormitory—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 那是他的舊宿舍。

options.text: Broken heating means no happy memories could be real—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 不便與快樂回憶可以並存。

items.promptEn: Videos made a faraway island appealing to Yi; living there exposed supply problems during typhoon season.
items.promptZh: 遠方島嶼的影片令阿怡嚮往；實際住下後，才感到颱風季補給不便。

options.text: The distant picture was enchanting before Yi met the supply problem—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 遠距離影像遮蔽了季節性的生活困難。

options.text: Supplies were easy to obtain during every typhoon—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說颱風季補給不便。

options.text: Yi had already lived through typhoon season before watching the videos—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 她在住下後才體會。

options.text: Supply problems prove the island has no appeal at all—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 有困難不等於完全無吸引力。

items.promptEn: Long missed the freedom of an old job; a friend reminded him of frequent emergency calls on holidays.
items.promptZh: 阿朗想念以前打工的自由，朋友提醒他當時常在假日收到緊急電話。

options.text: Time made the old job seem freer than it really was—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 回憶美化了舊工作的自由程度。

options.text: The old job never interrupted any holiday—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說假日常有緊急電話。

options.text: Long had not worked at that job—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 這是他的舊工作。

options.text: Emergency calls prove Long hated every part of it—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 受打擾不等於完全討厭工作。

items.promptEn: A mountain lodge looked like an escape from afar; after checking in, Man found the nearest restaurant far away.
items.promptZh: 遠看山中旅館像世外桃源；阿文入住後才知道餐廳離得很遠。

options.text: The distant impression left out a daily practical detail—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 遠景與實際用餐安排有落差。

options.text: The restaurant was next door—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說餐廳很遠。

options.text: Man had stayed there before forming his first impression—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 他入住後才發現。

options.text: A distant restaurant proves the lodge has no merits—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 一項不便不能否定全部優點。

items.promptEn: Old photos made Chun remember perfect childhood summers; her mother recalled sleepless nights caused by mosquitoes.
items.promptZh: 舊照片讓阿珍覺得童年暑假完美，母親提醒她當年常因蚊患睡不好。

options.text: Time and photos made Chun overlook an uncomfortable part of those summers—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 多年後的照片淡化了不舒服的經歷。

options.text: Chun remembered the sleepless nights first—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 她起初只記得完美暑假。

options.text: The family had never taken summer photos—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文有舊照片。

options.text: Mosquitoes prove every summer memory was false—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 不適不等於所有快樂回憶虛假。

items.promptEn: From another country, Ning recalled her old city’s parks but forgot the nightly building noise.
items.promptZh: 從另一國回望舊城市，阿寧只記得漂亮的公園，忘了當時每晚的施工噪音。

options.text: Distance made the old city seem quieter than it had been—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 離開後淡忘噪音，印象被美化。

options.text: Ning recalled the nightly noise clearly—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 原文說忘了噪音。

options.text: There had been no building work in the city—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 題目說當時每晚有施工。

options.text: Beautiful parks prove the city had no problems—distance lends enchantment to the view.
options.reasonZh: 公園漂亮不代表沒有問題。

meaning.zh: 離得遠時，景物、回憶或生活可能顯得更美好，因為煩難細節不在眼前。
meaning.en: Distance can make a view or imagined experience more appealing by softening its everyday difficulties.

model.zh: 在外地的阿文懷念舊工作，卻忘了當時天天加班。
model.en: Away from home, Man remembered his old job fondly but forgot the daily overtime—distance lends enchantment to the view.

picture.zh: 遠鏡把雜亂小路縮成一幅漂亮風景。
picture.en: A distant view turns a messy path into a graceful shape.

boundary.zh: 這句可談空間或時間造成的美化，不是說遠處的每樣東西都只是幻象。
boundary.en: The distance may be physical or in time; the proverb does not make every distant attraction false.

where.zh: 適合回望舊工作、遠望旅遊地點或想像陌生生活時提醒自己補看細節。
where.en: Use it when recalling a past job or imagining a remote place without its ordinary details.

tone.zh: 文學味較濃，帶反思和含蓄的提醒；日常口語可改說「遠看比較美」。
tone.en: Literary and reflective; in casual speech, a plainer paraphrase may sound more natural.

checks.zh: 是時間距離還是地理距離？
checks.en: Is the distance in time or place?

checks.zh: 我有沒有憑想像斷言現實？
checks.en: Am I asserting reality from an impression?

readAloud.zh: 多年後回想宿舍生活，我只記得笑聲，忘記了漏水的天花板。
readAloud.en: Years later, I remember the laughter in our old dormitory and forget the leaking ceiling—distance lends enchantment to the view.

prompt.zh: 哪個情境最能顯示距離美化了印象？
prompt.en: Which scene shows distance making something seem better?

options.zh: 離職多年後，她只記得熱鬧的同事，淡忘了每天的通宵工作。
options.en: Years after leaving, she remembers the lively colleagues but forgets the nightly overtime.
options.reasonZh: 時間拉遠後，困難細節被淡化。

options.zh: 她剛離職，清楚記得工作有好也有壞。
options.en: She has just left and remembers both the good and the bad clearly.
options.reasonZh: 沒有美化的線索。

options.zh: 她從遠處看見燈塔，卻沒評價它。
options.en: She sees a lighthouse from afar but makes no judgment about it.
options.reasonZh: 只有物理距離，沒有印象變美。

prompt.zh: 朋友懷念以前的學校，卻只提開心片段。哪個回應合宜？
prompt.en: A friend recalls only happy parts of an old school. Which reply is helpful?

options.zh: 「那些回憶很珍貴；你還記得當時的難處嗎？」
options.en: “Those memories matter. Do you remember any difficulties as well?”
options.reasonZh: 承認回憶，同時補看被淡化的細節。

options.zh: 「你現在懷念它，證明以前的生活完全沒有困難。」
options.en: “Missing it now proves life there had no difficulties.”
options.reasonZh: 懷念不能證明沒有困難。

options.zh: 「距離使景物更迷人，所以你的回憶必定是假的。」
options.en: “Distance lends enchantment, so your memories must be false.”
options.reasonZh: 美化不等於所有回憶都虛假。

prompt.zh: 遠方山屋在照片中很迷人，到場後才見到崎嶇的路。哪句貼切？
prompt.en: A remote cabin looks lovely in photos; on arrival, the rough road appears. Which line fits?

options.zh: 「照片沒拍到那條路；距離使景物更迷人。」
options.en: “The photos hid the rough road—distance lends enchantment to the view.”
options.reasonZh: 把遠觀與近處新見的困難連起來。

options.zh: 「崎嶇的路一開始就清楚拍出；距離使景物更迷人。」
options.en: “The rough road was clearly shown from the start—distance lends enchantment to the view.”
options.reasonZh: 與照片沒有呈現道路的事實相反。

options.zh: 「照片證明山屋不能居住；距離使景物更迷人。」
options.en: “The photos prove the cabin cannot be lived in—distance lends enchantment to the view.”
options.reasonZh: 題目只交代道路崎嶇，沒有不能居住的證據。

options.zh: 「遠觀可能令缺點不顯眼，仍須查證具體情況。」
options.en: “Distance may hide drawbacks, so we should check the details.”
options.reasonZh: 保留可能性和查證空間。

options.en: “The farther away we are, the more accurately we see.”
options.reasonZh: 與諺語提醒的認知偏差相反。

options.zh: 「凡是遠處看來美的東西，近看必定很差。」
options.en: “Anything attractive from afar must be poor up close.”
options.reasonZh: 把可能的落差說成必然。
